cover.coreProposition: Connector governance must keep administrative availability, configured capability, acting principal/account, target-resource permission, runtime policy and provider effect evidence separate; installation or enablement cannot authorize a call by itself.
cover.visualMetaphor: A single call token passes through six independently aligned authority layers before reaching an external effect
cover.semanticObject: One luminous call token crossing six offset translucent gates, each with a distinct shape and alignment
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one left-to-right call path, six deep layers and a remote effect surface
